name: 11856-prefillheavy-qwen3next80b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct, bf16, no quantization_config in the checkpoint.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, one whole a3 node. No router and no cache tier outside the node.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1, no DP attention.
architecture: Qwen3NextForCausalLM, hybrid: 12 full-attention and 36 gated-DeltaNet linear-attention layers, sparse MoE on every layer (512 experts, top-10); 80B parameters, ~3B active per token, ~160 GB of bf16 weights.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 4.0 req/s, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 800 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix. Every prompt is exactly 3500 tokens and every completion exactly 1000 tokens under `ignore_eos: true` at `temperature: 0.0`, issued to `/v1/completions` so no chat template inflates the prompt. Seed 11856.
purpose: A document analysis service summarizing long reports for analysts, with an 80-billion-parameter model on eight GPUs at four requests per second.
launch:
# sglang at commit 28b8c5792dc8a4d0f4b8f9f7ffc595eaeb17214a (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.5.5.post1-44-g28b8c5792dc), one whole node serving Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct.
#
# FLAT PARSER: `sglang serve` CLI form, one `key: value` per line. A nested block is DROPPED
# silently, which would run the engine without a mechanism this file claims to declare.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct

tp-size: 8
ep-size: 8

# Has to be WRITTEN rather than assumed: at this commit the engine force-disables the prefix cache
# only for the FalconH1/NemotronH config classes, and Qwen3-Next is not one of them.
disable-radix-cache: true

chunked-prefill-size: -1

mem-fraction-static: 0.80
cuda-graph-max-bs: 128
enable-metrics: true

random-seed: 11856

# Deliberately absent, at their release defaults: host / port / served-model-name (owned by
# whatever starts the server), max-running-requests, max-prefill-tokens, attention-backend,
# context-length, page-size, dtype, quantization, max-mamba-cache-size.
